Privacy Policy

Pawprint collects only what it needs to run the service, keeps exact capture locations private, and never sells personal information. This policy is written with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and its implementing rules in mind.

Privacy contact: John Carlo M. Manalo, Muntinlupa City, Philippines. For privacy questions or requests, contact our privacy/DPO contact at hello.pawprint.app@gmail.com.

1. Who is responsible

The personal information controller for Pawprint is John Carlo M. Manalo, Muntinlupa City, Philippines. While Pawprint is operated by the owner directly, the same email address above handles Data Protection Officer and privacy concerns.

2. What we collect

  • Your email address and sign-in data, handled by Supabase Auth. Pawprint does not see or store your password in plain text.
  • Cat photos you submit through a capture.
  • Capture-time location, only after device permission and only when you submit a sighting. We do not track location in the background.
  • Your private Journal, sightings, streaks, XP, medals, quests, Care Flags, and reports.
  • Basic device and error information needed to keep the service working.
  • Early-access email and platform choice when you join the launch list.

3. How we use information

  • To run your account, Journal, streaks, rewards, and community features.
  • To validate that submitted media contains a cat and to reduce duplicate or unsafe posts.
  • To show an approximate, delayed public pin without exposing the exact point.
  • To send account, service, and launch emails you requested.
  • To handle reports, Care Flags, abuse, fraud, and security.

Our legal bases may include consent, providing the service you requested, and legitimate interests in keeping Pawprint and its community safe.

4. Location protection

Your exact capture point is stored on the server only. It is never returned to other users. Public pins show an area of roughly 100–200 metres, appear after at least a 5-minute delay, and disappear after 24 hours. Photos are re-encoded before storage to remove GPS and other metadata.

5. Service providers

We share information only with providers that help us operate Pawprint:

ProviderPurpose
SupabaseDatabase, authentication, and private photo storage.
BrevoAccount and launch-update email delivery.
VercelWebsite hosting and delivery.

Some providers may process data outside the Philippines. We require appropriate safeguards and do not sell personal information or use it for third-party advertising.

6. Retention

  • Public pins are removed after 24 hours.
  • Photos, exact capture points, and Journal records are kept while your account is active and deleted within 30 days after account deletion.
  • Early-access emails are kept until you unsubscribe or the launch campaign ends.
  • Security and abuse records may be kept for up to 12 months or longer when required by law.

7. Your rights

Under RA 10173, you may ask to be informed, access your data, correct inaccurate data, object to processing or withdraw consent where applicable, request erasure or blocking, and receive a portable copy. You may also complain to the National Privacy Commission.

Use Profile in the app for Download my data or Delete account, or email hello.pawprint.app@gmail.com from your account address. We aim to respond within 15 days.

8. Children and security

Pawprint is for people aged 13 and above. Anyone under 18 needs parent or guardian permission. If we learn that a child under 13 has an account, we will delete it. We use access controls, row-level security, private storage, signed links, and encryption in transit, but no system is perfectly secure.

9. Changes

For a material change, we will show notice in the app or on this page before it takes effect.
